After accidentally answering her flatmate Veronica's phone, she decides that if being Tess isn't going so well, why shouldn't she try being Veronica? Throwing caution to the wind, she accepts Veronica's photography assignment to an exotic island - she used to be an amateur snapper, how hard can it be? Right?
